Description: During maintenance, a worker entered a confined space without atmospheric testing. No standby person was present.
A technician was working at height on a platform without proper fall protection or a secured safety harness.
An electrician began maintenance work without isolating the electrical supply. The equipment remained energized during the work.
A machine operator removed the machine guard to clear material while the machine was still running.
Workers were wearing the required PPE and following the approved maintenance procedure during routine equipment inspection.
